title: CONNECT-IP ADDRESS_REQUEST Capsule Architecture
purpose: Define RFC 9484 ADDRESS_REQUEST capsule wire format and address-assignment response policy.
design_summary: `Http3ConnectIpAddressRequestCapsule` creates and parses Capsule Type 0x02, enforces non-empty Requested Address lists, unique non-zero Request IDs, IP version/address/prefix validation, and maps malformed fields to HTTP/3 message errors. The helper also models when ADDRESS_REQUEST is sent, unprompted ADDRESS_ASSIGN permission, matching Assigned Address responses, unassigned zero-address responses, and exclusion of rejected addresses from later assignments.
data_and_state_considerations: The codec is stateless and leaves actual address-pool allocation to adapters. Request ID uniqueness is validated per capsule input.
edge_cases_and_constraints: Empty ADDRESS_REQUEST capsules abort the request stream.
Unassigned responses use all-zero addresses with maximum prefix length.
Request IDs must be non-zero and unique.
risks: Route advertisement wire format remains a separate RFC 9484 slice.
Live address-pool allocation and tunnel state integration remain adapter work.
